costs.haircut_note: C8: entry at 120 s and exit at 60 s before the close are inside the last 2 minutes, so 2c is PRIMARY (PF 1.3 at 2c, halves 1.0 or more); 1c is secondary only; every figure is 'upper bound, not fill-checked'
costs.fee: ceil(round(100*0.07*c*p*(1-p),9))/100 per order on the order's own price; void refunds the price and keeps the fee

tries.prior_m: 96 new tries (12 bands x 2 sides yes and no x 2 filters x 2 exits x 1 bucket) plus the carried tally the Head names (Auditor B sent the Head options A and B; the number is inserted when named); BH over the total; bars on unrounded figures

prediction: no survivor: PF under 1.0 at 2c in most cells; most cells will print 'no evidence at n = x' (about 308 events with a quote in the window across 12 bands, so n under 100 in nearly every cell)
kill: no cell with PF 1.3 at 2c and halves 1.0 or more, n 100, 10 days; kill_fast drops the family at PF under 1.0 at 2c on the first read

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days

rules.two_sided: 0 < bid < ask < 1 for the side taken (rule 18)
rules.cheap_side: the lower ask of the two sides at the look (the YES ask against 1 minus the YES bid); a tie goes to YES
rules.look: the last recorder row at or before the close minus 120 s, and no more than 60 s old (else no entry for that event)
rules.exit_M60: the bid of the last row at or before the close minus 60 s; none: held to settlement (both printed)
rules.spread_filter: round trip spread (ask minus bid) of the side taken at most 0.03 (a number, fixed now)
